The '''Typhonic Nebula''' was a [[nebula]] in the [[Mid Rim Territories]]<ref name="Galaxy Map" /> that was said to be the birthplace of [[Hylemane Lightbringer]], a [[regent]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] who claimed that by being born from the nebula's dust, he could not be [[Death|killed]] by mortal weapons.<ref name="Aftermath">[[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']]</ref> The [[Arakurth]] [[species]] lived within the nebula. In [[35 ABY]], [[Poe Dameron]] briefly [[Hyperspace skipping|skipped]] the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'' into the nebula's [[Megafauna Chasm]] while evading [[First Order]] [[TIE/wi Interceptor]]s.<ref name="TROSVD" />
